questions.question: God told the prophet Jeremiah to buy a linen loincloth and wear it. What was it not allowed to touch?
After many days hidden in the rocks, what shape was Jeremiah's linen loincloth in when he dug it up?

answers.text: Ruined and of no use at all
Clean as the day he bought it
Faded but still fine to wear

questions.question: God had Jeremiah hide a linen loincloth until it was ruined. What did God say He would ruin in the same way?

answers.text: The pride of Judah and Jerusalem
The harvest of Judah and Jerusalem
The walls of Judah and Jerusalem

questions.question: God said He made Israel and Judah cling to Him like a loincloth clings to a man's waist. Why?

answers.text: To be His people for His glory
To keep them safe from every war
To make them richer than the nations
